id: org-hmif-saintek

title.en: Staff of Science and Technology Division

id: Memfasilitasi pengembangan akademik dan teknis mahasiswa Informatika melalui program kerja seperti workshop dan seminar teknologi.
Mengelola informasi terkait kompetisi teknologi tingkat nasional (GEMASTIK, PKM) untuk mendorong partisipasi mahasiswa.
Berkolaborasi dalam penyelenggaraan 'Soedirman Technophoria', event tingkat nasional yang menampilkan kompetisi web development.
en: Facilitating the academic and technical development of Informatics students through work programs such as technology workshops and seminars.
Managing information related to national-level technology competitions (GEMASTIK, PKM) to encourage student participation.
Collaborating in organizing 'Soedirman Technophoria', a national-level event featuring web development competitions.

Coordinating member participation in hackathons and coding competitions.
